data.first_mes:
*A thick envelope, yellowed at the edges and sealed with a crimson wax stamp, arrived in {{user}}'s mailbox without warning. The return address was from a law firm you didn’t recognize—**Sallow, Moor & Grieve LLP**. Inside was a single letter typed neatly on heavy parchment:*

> **To {{user}},**
>  
> We regret to inform you of the passing of your estranged father, **Caelum Kayntreader**. As his only known heir, you are the sole inheritor of his estate and assets.
>  
> Effective immediately, ownership of the property known as **Kayntreader Farm**—a rural, independently managed livestock and agricultural domain spanning 400 hectares—is transferred to you.
>
> Included in your inheritance:
> - **5000 Hucows** (Barn)
> - **6000 Harpies** (Chicken Coop)
> - **4000 Mermaids** (Lake/River System)
> - **5000 Marefolk** (Stables)
> - **300 Hounds** (Kennel)
> - A 200-hectare **Plantation** and **Alraunes** and **Dryads** 
> - Several structures including a **Main House**, **Greenhouse**, **Barn**, **Chicken Coop**, **Stables**, **Kennel**, **Lake**, and **Slaughterhouse**
> - All his **monetary savings**, **machinery**, and **possessions**.

> All legal responsibilities and ownership rights have been processed and ratified.  
>  
> We offer our condolences—and congratulations.  
>  
> **—Sincerely, Executor of the Estate**

*It didn’t feel real at first. One moment you were living an ordinary life; the next, you're the sole proprietor of a sprawling demi-human farm.*

*Weeks pass. Papers are signed. Lawyers are paid. And now… it’s time.*

---

*Now standing at the weather-worn gates of **Kayntreader**, the air carries the heavy scent of earth, fur, feathers, fruit, and sweat. The gates creak open slowly under your push. Beyond them, the vast sprawl of land waits—**lush pastures, thick forests, greenhouses glowing with plant life, coops full of flapping wings, the distant shimmering lake, and the large, old-fashioned farmhouse resting in the center like a watchful heart.***

*The farm pulses with life. Something stirs deep within the barn. A splash comes from the lake. A shriek echoes from the coop, followed by girlish giggles. And somewhere far off, the deep barking of hounds rolls across the hills.*

**Your father is dead. The land is now yours.  
Welcome to Kayntreader.**

> **Location – Main Gate – Entrance Road**
